headings.usage: Use Outfit for all dashboard titles, metric numbers, and section headers. Enforce tight tracking (tracking-tight).

body.usage: Use Inter for all lists, tables, data points, and task descriptions. Ensure readability with leading-relaxed.

primary.description: Emerald Green (Nabawi Mosque Dome Green) - Use for active states, main CTAs, and positive progress.

secondary.description: Warm Gold - Use for Amaliyah (Spiritual) tracking streaks, special badges, or warning states.

background.description: App background is a very soft slate/sand to give a calm, grounded feel. Sidebar is a deep forest green for strong contrast.

dashboard_grid.description: High Density Grid for the SPV Overview and User Workspace. Every pixel must be utilized with tight gaps.

spacing.generous: Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards to let data breathe. Avoid cramped tables.
spacing.optical_alignment: Align text left, especially in tables and trackers. Center only empty states.

surfaces.cards: Flat solid surfaces with crisp 1px borders (border-slate-200). Subtle rounded-xl radius. No heavy drop shadows; use shadow-sm.
surfaces.sidebar: Solid dark green (bg-emerald-900) with a subtle texture or geometric pattern overlay for the Islamic feel.
surfaces.headers: Solid background (bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md) with a hard bottom border (border-b border-slate-200).

visual_enhancers.habit_grid: For the 'Amaliyah Spiritual' tracker, use a contribution graph style (like GitHub) but using varying shades of emerald green (bg-emerald-100 to bg-emerald-600) to represent task completion.
visual_enhancers.progress_bars: Use Shadcn Progress component. Override color to use primary Emerald Green. For OKRs, layer the text inside or right next to the bar.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Use peaceful nature imagery (like calm lakes or soft deserts) with low opacity, accompanied by soft encouraging text (e.g., 'Semua tugas telah selesai. Alhamdulillah.').

motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements (buttons, table rows) using transition-colors duration-200. Progress bars should animate their width on mount.
motion.lists: Staggered fade-in for task lists and table rows.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary actions, sharp standard (rounded-md) for utility buttons inside forms.
components.tables: Shadcn Table. Use hover:bg-slate-50 for rows. Left align all content except action menus.
components.tabs: Shadcn Tabs. Underline style preferred over pill style for dashboard navigation (Todo vs Amaliyah vs OKR).

patterns.description: Islamic geometric pattern green - Use as a subtle background overlay with 5-10% opacity in the sidebar or header banner.

empty_states.description: Peaceful lake - Use for empty state illustrations (e.g., No pending tasks)

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Use the emerald green color palette to reflect the 'hijau kubah mesjid nabawi' theme while maintaining a clean, modern SaaS aesthetic.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: For the Amaliyah Spiritual tracker, build a grid layout similar to a GitHub contribution chart. Provide visual feedback based on completion.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Implement role-based views. Ensure the SPV Dashboard shows an aggregated view (Execution scores, OKRs) of all team members.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: In the Workspace view, divide the interface into clear tabs: OKR & Initiatives, Execution Scoreboard (Tasks), and Amaliyah Tracker.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do not use completely transparent backgrounds for any dropdowns or overlays. Always use solid or heavily blurred backgrounds.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for testing.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.1: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.2: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.3: You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.4: You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.5: NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like robot or brain for icons.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.6: Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
